columns.name: camis
columns.description: An integer identifier for a restaurant or establishment in the inspection records; it ranges from 30075445 to 50179650.

columns.name: dba
columns.description: The establishment’s doing-business-as name, such as DUNKIN, STARBUCKS, or SUBWAY.

columns.name: boro
columns.description: The New York City borough where the establishment is located, recorded as one of Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, or Staten Island.

columns.name: building
columns.description: The building number portion of the establishment’s street address, stored as text; it is missing for about 0.8% of records.

columns.name: street
columns.description: The street name portion of the establishment’s address, such as BROADWAY or 5 AVENUE.

columns.name: zipcode
columns.description: The establishment’s ZIP code, stored as a numeric value, with observed values from 10000 to 11697; it is missing for about 1.4% of records.

columns.name: phone
columns.description: A contact telephone number stored as a string of digits, rather than a number for calculation.

columns.name: cuisine_description
columns.description: The cuisine or food-service category associated with the establishment, such as American, Chinese, or Pizza.

columns.name: inspection_date
columns.description: The date of the restaurant inspection, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: action
columns.description: The outcome or action recorded for an inspection, with values indicating cited violations, no violations recorded, closure, or reopening.
domain_values: Establishment Closed by DOHMH. Violations were cited in the following area(s) and those requiring immediate action were addressed.
No violations were recorded at the time of this inspection.
Violations were cited in the following area(s).

columns.name: violation_code
columns.description: A short code identifying a cited inspection violation; the code is distinct from the corresponding text description, and some records have no code.

columns.name: violation_description
columns.description: Text describing the inspection violation, such as pest conditions or food-temperature issues; some records have no description.

columns.name: critical_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether a violation is marked Critical or Not Critical, or is Not Applicable.

columns.name: score
columns.description: The numeric score recorded for an inspection, ranging from 0 to 154; the profile does not specify a scale or unit.

columns.name: grade
columns.description: The inspection grade, recorded as A, B, or C.

columns.name: grade_date
columns.description: The date associated with the recorded grade, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: record_date
columns.description: The date of the data record or snapshot, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD; all profiled records have the value 2025-12-26.

columns.name: inspection_type
columns.description: The inspection category and stage, combining Cycle Inspection or Pre-permit (Operational) with Initial Inspection, Re-inspection, or Reopening Inspection.

columns.name: inspection_year
columns.description: The calendar year of the inspection, recorded as a four-digit year from 2022 through 2025.

columns.name: inspection_order
columns.description: An integer inspection-order value ranging from 1 to 6; it represents an order or sequence number, though the profile does not define the sequencing scheme.

columns.name: days_to_next_inspection
columns.description: The number of days until the next inspection, with observed intervals from 3 to 1093 days; it is missing for about 47.8% of records.
